hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A meme coin launchpad hook (pmav.fun v2.2) that implements a bonding curve via a concentrated Uniswap v4 position, enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap semantics, charges a 1% fee split 70/30 between creator and platform, and graduates coins to a permanently locked full-range pool when the curve is exhausted.
